rule: Only open datasets listed below may be used. NASA sources first. No dataset, mission, model weights or service produced by or associated with China. No pretrained third-party ML weights.

datasets.name: SPHEREx DR1 Level 2 spectral images (and QR3)
datasets.licence: Public domain (NASA data policy); cite DOI 10.26131/IRSA652 (QR2) and the DR1 DOI
datasets.used_for: search images, flags, variance, PSF, per-pixel wavelength

datasets.name: JPL Horizons ephemeris API
datasets.used_for: SPHEREx spacecraft (-163182) and Earth heliocentric positions at each exposure

datasets.name: JPL Small-Body Identification API
datasets.used_for: known asteroids and comets in each patch

datasets.name: Planet Nine reference population, Version 3.0 (Brown 2023)
datasets.used_for: 100,000 synthetic Planet Nine orbits with ZTF/DES/PS1 exclusion flags
